operations.name: decision.create
operations.description: Record one desk decision. Every field is optional; the title defaults to 'New decision' and the status to 'proposed'.

decision_id.description: Optional; a new id is made when absent.

operations.principal: derived by the transport (HTTP auth middleware; MCP auth resolver); the desk decision service performs no principal check of its own
operations.result: the decision record (id, title, status, deciders, decided_at, the three markdown fields, alternatives, superseded_by, tags, created_at, updated_at, deleted)
operations.completion: synchronous; the returned id reads back through decision.read; one desk_changed frame (kind decision, op create) on the hub bus

operations.name: decision.update
operations.description: Change fields of one desk decision. Only the supplied fields change; null leaves a field as it is; unknown fields are ignored.

superseded_by.description: The id of the decision that replaces this one.

operations.principal: derived by the transport (HTTP auth middleware; MCP auth resolver); the desk decision service performs no principal check of its own
operations.completion: synchronous; decision.read returns the new state; one desk_changed frame (kind decision, op update) on the hub bus

operations.name: decision.read
operations.description: Read one desk decision by id.
operations.principal: derived by the transport (HTTP auth middleware; MCP auth resolver); the desk decision service performs no principal check of its own

operations.name: decision.list
operations.description: List the desk decisions that are not deleted, most recently updated first. The empty object lists up to 500; limit asks for 1 to 2000.
operations.principal: derived by the transport (HTTP auth middleware; MCP auth resolver); the desk decision service performs no principal check of its own

operations.name: meeting.list
operations.description: List or search the archived meetings, newest first, with optional filters. The empty object lists the first 50.

cursor.description: An offset or the previous page's next_cursor.

operations.principal: derived by the transport (HTTP auth middleware; MCP auth resolver) and passed to the service unchanged
operations.result: {meetings: [meeting summaries], total, next_cursor} (HTTP drops next_cursor; its offset is the cursor)

operations.name: meeting.read
operations.description: Read one meeting: transcript, summary, intelligence job state, the planned route with its selection hash, and the run receipt. This is also how a summary run and an import are read back.
operations.principal: derived by the transport (HTTP auth middleware; MCP auth resolver) and passed to the service unchanged
operations.result: the meeting detail (planned_route.selection_hash, intel, intel_status, run_receipt, segments ...)

operations.name: meeting.import
operations.description: Import one recording or transcript file the hub already holds. Makes the visible importing meeting now and transcribes in the background.

filename.description: The original file name; its extension picks audio or transcript.

title.description: Defaults to the file name without its extension.

occurred_at.description: ISO 8601 date and time the meeting happened; defaults to now.

operations.principal: derived by the transport (HTTP auth middleware; MCP auth resolver) and passed to the service unchanged; the background transcription runs under that same principal
refusals: ValidationError: occurred_at is not an ISO 8601 date and time
operations.completion: asynchronous; read meeting.read until intel_status leaves importing (import_failed carries the reason); one desk_changed frame (kind meeting, op update) when the worker ends

operations.name: meeting.summary.run
operations.description: Queue a fresh summary (meeting intelligence) run with the selection hash read from meeting.read. Refused when the hash is absent or stale, or the meeting has no transcript.
operations.principal: derived by the transport (HTTP auth middleware; MCP auth resolver) and passed to the service unchanged
operations.result: {jobId, state: queued, host, drainer, expectedWithinSeconds, planned_route, run_receipt}
refusals: ConflictError: empty | stale selection hash | reserved | running | ready (with planned_route, run_receipt, last_refusal)
operations.completion: asynchronous; one runtime_queue frame on the hub bus when queued; read meeting.read for the job state, the summary and the run receipt

operations.name: brief.generate
operations.description: Make today's brief from durable sources on the producer's clock. A second call on the same producer day returns that day's brief.
operations.principal: derived by the transport (HTTP auth middleware; MCP auth resolver) and passed to the service unchanged
operations.result: the brief (id, generated_at, period_start, period_end, sections with brief-scoped item ids, shelf)

operations.name: brief.latest
operations.description: Read the most recently made brief, or nothing when none exists.
operations.principal: derived by the transport (HTTP auth middleware; MCP auth resolver) and passed to the service unchanged

operations.name: brief.shelf.write
operations.description: Set one brief item's triage state: acknowledged, deferred, or null to return it to untouched.
operations.principal: derived by the transport (HTTP auth middleware; MCP auth resolver) and passed to the service unchanged
operations.completion: synchronous; brief.shelf.read returns the new state

operations.name: brief.shelf.read
operations.description: Read the triage states of the latest brief's items.
operations.principal: derived by the transport (HTTP auth middleware; MCP auth resolver) and passed to the service unchanged
operations.result: {item_id: state} for the latest brief; {} when there is none

operations.name: thought.create
operations.description: Make one durable Thought from raw text, with the hub's default AI context applied.
operations.principal: derived by the transport (HTTP auth middleware; MCP auth resolver) and passed to the service unchanged
refusals: ValidationError / ConflictError with the Thought service's own codes

operations.name: thought.save
operations.description: Save the working copy of one Thought under its revision checks (KEPT). Never invokes a model and never completes the Thought.
operations.principal: derived by the transport (HTTP auth middleware; MCP auth resolver) and passed to the service unchanged
operations.completion: synchronous; thought.read and thought.workbench.read return the saved state

operations.name: thought.read
operations.description: Read one Thought: its working note, revisions and lifecycle.
operations.principal: derived by the transport (HTTP auth middleware; MCP auth resolver) and passed to the service unchanged

operations.name: thought.workbench.read
operations.description: Read one Thought's workbench: the Thought, its context, its review state and the workspace cursor.
operations.principal: derived by the transport (HTTP auth middleware; MCP auth resolver) and passed to the service unchanged

operations.name: thought.list
operations.description: List the unfinished Thoughts, one page at a time.
operations.principal: derived by the transport (HTTP auth middleware; MCP auth resolver) and passed to the service unchanged
refusals: ValidationError with the Thought service's own codes
